text:
mike: quick ping — PR #24321 is blocked on CI, failing integration shard 9 on the KV cache tests. Can reviewers take a quick look?

mike: failure looks nondeterministic, repro in buildkite job 98765. error snippet: ```
E TestKVCacheEvict::evict_ordering
  expected 0 but got 1 at cache.cc:214
```

alice: ack, I can spare a few mins. which commit is this on?

mike: it's the tip of branch `feature/evict-tweak` (sha 5f3a2). I landed a micro-optimization to eviction heuristics — might have timing implications.

sam: hm I skimmed the diff earlier. there's a small sleep removal in kv_store that could affect ordering under heavy load. worth a targeted rerun first.

jen: +1 on rerun. if it flakes we shouldn't update snapshots. prefer to rerun 3x then decide.

mike: requesting targeted rerun now: `./scripts/ci retry --pr 24321 --shard 9 --attempts 3`

devops-bot: queued targeted rerun for PR 24321 (shard 9) — buildkite job ids 98766, 98767, 98768.

ci-bot: job 98766 started on gpu-pool-4. logs: `Starting test shard 9...`

alice: I'll look at logs while rerun runs. if it's the same assertion across runs we should bisect.

ci-bot: job 98766 finished — flaky test passed. job 98767 started.

mike: thanks — can someone decide if we should hold merge? merge window closes at 17:00 PST.

jen: if second run passes, still run third. if any run fails at the same assertion, hold and bisect. otherwise we can merge after 3 green.

ci-bot: job 98767 finished — failed with same assertion.

sam: OK that's suspicious. I'll start a quick bisect locally and try to reproduce with `--stress` on shard 9.

alice: eyes on the failure stackpoint: `cache.cc:214 evict_ordering` — looks like a race around the eviction callback.

mike: rough ETA on bisect? we need to know before the end of the day to decide merge hold.

sam: give me ~90m. I'll post updates in this thread.

devops-bot: job 98768 queued.

ci-bot: job 98768 finished — passed.

jen: 2/3 passed, 1 failed same assertion. I recommend we hold the merge and label PR with `ci:flaky` and `hold-for-bisect`. reviewers, can we convert to draft while sam bisects?

alice: +1 convert to draft. want a clean green before merging.

mike: switching to draft now, adding labels. thanks all for quick responses. :thumbsup:

sam: update: reproduced locally with `--stress --threads=16` and will bisect commits in the branch. will post a short summary when I find the regression.

mike: appreciated. if you need a hand reproing i can throw a dev box on the same image.

sam: might take me 30m, I may ask for that.

alice: tagging @qa for heads-up in case any flaky metrics need note.

jen: noted. I'll add a quick note to the release board; we may delay the merge window if bisect finds a regression.

mike: thanks — leaving this thread open for bisect updates.

sam: (after bisect) found culprit: commit 5f3a2 removed an ordering fence in kv_store; reintroducing a small memory barrier fixes tests. sending hotfix soon.

alice: nice find. once hotfix PR is up ping here and we can rerun targeted shard 9.

mike: great turnaround. ping when you have the PR and I'll prioritize review.

jen: once hotfix is approved we can unblock merge; no snapshot updates needed since test behavior was a race.

ci-bot: adding note to job 98767: flaky test detected — inconsistent across retries.

mike: closing loop — hotfix PR #24345 opened, ran targeted shard 9 x3 all green, converting original PR back to ready and re-requesting review. thanks everyone.
